inputs.goal: hire a senior backend engineer who can own our payments service

define-role.intake.summary: Need to identify and hire a senior backend engineer with payments domain expertise to own our payment service. Must evaluate technical skills in scalable system design, payment processing protocols, security compliance, and experience with financial services.

define-role.generate.draft:
Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Service Owner

Position Overview:
We're seeking an experienced senior backend engineer to lead our payments service development. This role requires deep technical expertise in payment processing systems, scalable architecture, and financial compliance.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement secure, high-throughput payment processing services
- Lead technical architecture decisions for payment infrastructure
- Collaborate with security teams to ensure PCI DSS compliance
- mentor junior engineers and drive technical excellence
- Own full lifecycle of payment service development from conception to production

Required Skills:
- 5+ years backend engineering experience with payment systems
- Strong knowledge of payment protocols (PCI, SEPA, SWIFT, etc.)
- Experience with distributed systems and microservices architecture
- Deep understanding of financial services security requirements
- Proficiency in Go/Java/Python with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
- Hands-on experience with database design for transactional systems

Bonus Points:
- Previous experience in fintech or e-commerce environments
- Knowledge of fraud detection systems
- Experience with payment gateway integrations

Compensation: Competitive + equity package
